points.label: Question about change
points.left: Hebrews describes high-priestly appointment, recalls Aaron, quotes the Son and priestly sayings, and says God named Christ a high priest after Melchizedek’s order.
points.right: Hebrews asks why another priest was needed, contrasts Aaron’s order with Melchizedek’s likeness, and links changed priesthood with changed law and a better hope.

payload.posture: Read both passages while keeping each speaker, setting, action, and later argument in its own setting.

rightEvidence.title: Hebrews asks why another priest arises outside Aaron’s order

payload.tension: Both passages mention Aaron, but the later passage presses the difference between descent and another priestly likeness.
payload.title: Aaron’s order and another priest
